correctness.rationale: Every fixed barycentric support is a union of admissible whole edge-orbits; admissible cross-orbit matchings are exactly equivariant bijections, and internal orbit matchings are equivariant fixed-point-free involutions. Their occupied H-orbits are pairwise disjoint precisely for the colored position matching model. The PL inverse and exact face polynomial follow. For two regular orbits, D_s*D_s and k isolated points give the integral Betti formula. Fifteen independently enumerated finite actions check all admissible orbits and all face counts, but are not substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: An all-finite-group PL and face-polynomial structural classification from natural normalizer/involution data; for two regular orbits it gives a complete integral homotopy profile distinguishing same-order nonisomorphic groups, with essential loops precisely when multiple involutions exist. This is not a mere numerical increment of the cyclic classification.
